content: A good name and an unblemished character are a golden shield that never rusts.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: Iron armor dents and corrodes; wooden shields split and burn. But a lifetime of integrity, keeping your promises, and defending the weak forms an invisible, diamond shield around your soul that neither slander nor time can tarnish. Protect your honor.
practicalInsight: Keep your word today, even on a minor promise that feels inconvenient to fulfill. Keep your shield polished.
reflectionPrompt: Is there any promise you made that you have neglected, leaving a tarnish on your shield of honor?
